subject: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist (AWS/Azure/GCP)
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@northpoint-sys.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 PST
Subject: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Laura —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is Northpoint's RFI (v2) for marketplace suppliers — sections cover metering/entitlements, private offers, regional data residency, KMS key ownership, and marketplace billing flows across AWS/Azure/GCP. We need answers and evidence to evaluate vendor eligibility for our cloud catalog by 2026-11-27.

Key asks (high level):
- Do you support SaaS metering (per-seat/active-user) and entitlement sync via marketplace APIs?
- Can you publish private offers (AWS Private Marketplace / Azure Marketplace -> Private Plans / GCP Procurement integrations)?
- What is your recommended architecture for a VPC/private deployment listed on marketplaces (BYOK/KMS, network isolation)?
- SOC2, penetration test reports, and marketplace onboarding artifacts — can you share or provide an attestation timeline?

Attached: Northpoint_RFI_v2.pdf (pdf), marketplace-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx).

Could you confirm point contacts and whether Redwood will provide marketplace listing artifacts (Listing images, SKU mapping, metering docs)?

Best,
Sam
Samantha Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager | Northpoint Systems
[Attachment: Northpoint_RFI_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: marketplace-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@northpoint-sys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15 10:08 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Sam —

Thanks for the RFI and the checklist. We can meet the Nov 27 evaluation window. I'll coordinate internal owners: Karthik will own marketplace metering/entitlements and SKU mapping; Marcus will own security/compliance evidence and deployment architecture for private listing.

Immediate notes:
- Redwood supports marketplace metering patterns across AWS (SaaS Metering & SaaS Contracts), Azure Marketplace plans, and GCP SaaS Metering integrations. We support both usage-based and seat-based models; we can provide entitlement sync via SCIM or marketplace-provided APIs where required.
- Private offers and private plan publishing are supported for all three clouds; implementation details differ by provider (we'll call out the operational steps per cloud).
- BYOK/KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments (KMS/HSM integrations) and can provide guidance for Bring-Your-Own-Key on marketplace images or private offers.

I'll pull the evidence bundle and a concise vendor response matrix (answers + supporting artifacts) and share by EOD 2026-11-18 for your initial review.

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Signature]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16 08:37 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Laura / Marcus —

I'll draft the 'Marketplace Technical Appendix' that covers:
- Metering model support (APIs, SKU mapping, reconciliation cadence) for AWS, Azure, GCP.
- Entitlement sync options: SCIM, marketplace entitlement callbacks, and our recommended fallback (JWT + backend reconciliation).
- Integration diagrams for Private Offer flows: AWS private offers + contracts, Azure private plans + offer listing, GCP GCPCloud Marketplace private pricing.

Questions for Sam (we should confirm before I finalize):
1) Which specific SKU/pricing model will Northpoint prefer — per-instance, per-seat, or usage-based token units?
2) Will Northpoint require monthly reconciliations tied to billing exports, or real-time webhook-based entitlements for seat changes?

I'll attach the draft appendix in the shared Drive and link the sample webhook payloads. Marcus, please confirm compliance artifacts you can attach (SOC2 cert file name, pen test summary, encryption architecture diagram).

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16 09:22 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Karthik —

I can provide:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted report) — file: SOC2_Redwood_2026_redacted.pdf
- Penetration test executive summary — file: pen-test-summary-2026.pdf
- Data residency note and recommended deployment patterns per region (we will outline a multi-region private listing with data-in-region controls) — doc: marketplace-deploy-patterns.pdf
- Encryption & KMS details: we support AWS KMS CMKs (customer-owned), Azure Key Vault BYOK, and GCP CMEK integration patterns.

One red flag I want to pre-empt: Northpoint has asked for audit logs for marketplace transactions — we can provide per-tenant audit logs in Redwood Private and in Dedicated, but our hosted shared offering provides aggregated billing and token-level logs; for full per-tenant raw logs we're proposing Dedicated or Private plan for compliance. I'll note that explicitly in the response matrix.

I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive folder and mark which ones are redact-safe for sharing.

Marcus

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@northpoint-sys.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@northpoint-sys.com
Date: 2026-11-18 11:04 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Laura / Team —

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. To answer Karthik's questions:
1) Preferred pricing model: Northpoint expects a primary per-seat SKU with an overage usage bucket (tokens/minutes) for burst workloads. We need metering reconciliation monthly but an ability to revoke entitlements in near-real time (within 5 minutes) for license enforcement.
2) We will want the ability to publish a private offer in AWS and Azure, and use GCP private pricing where available. The procurement team will also run a legal review; any special contract language for marketplace listings should be highlighted.

We expect the vendor evidence bundle by 11/18 (per your plan). The evaluation committee will then ask follow-ups by 11/24 with final vendor selection on 11/30.

Cheers,
Sam

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@northpoint-sys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20 16:35 PST
Subject: Re: RFI: cloud marketplace procurement technical & risk checklist

Sam —

Appreciate the clarity on pricing and entitlements. Action plan and deliverables:
- 2026-11-18 (delivered): Draft vendor response matrix + evidence bundle (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-marketplace-northpoint) — includes SOC2_Redwood_2026_redacted.pdf, pen-test-summary-2026.pdf, marketplace-deploy-patterns.pdf, and a technical appendix for metering/webhook examples.
- 2026-11-23: Follow-up Q&A from Northpoint (if any).
- 2026-11-30: Final listing artifacts and SKU mapping for private offers (subject to legal sign-off).

Notes on enforcement & reconciliation:
- We can support near-real-time entitlement revocation using marketplace entitlement callbacks + our internal webhook queue; typical RPO for revocation is under 2 minutes end-to-end in Dedicated/Private; for hosted plans it's within 5 minutes depending on cloud provider latency.
- Monthly reconciliation: we provide a billing export that includes SKU-level usage and a reconciliation CSV.

I'll flag the Dedicated/Private option in the matrix as the default path for customers needing tenant-level audit logs and strict per-tenant raw log access.

I'll also include any redlines our legal team typically requests for marketplace terms (we'll surface them to your legal lead).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Redwood_2026_redacted.pdf]
